notes: What a class of facility is, before one is built and named. bufferPermille is the local storage a facility works out of, as a fraction of a full hold. commandable false means no player program may target it.

facilities.label: Emergency Hydrogen Extractor
facilities.notes: Passive by the GDD's rule, stated three times and once as a design rule: it is not an automation node and cannot be disabled by player programs, and it appears as a read-only source. It runs what it is configured with and is scheduled by nobody, so no scenario may queue a task on it. Without this flag it would become commandable by construction the moment programs are installable - not because anyone decided it should be, but because it is a facility in a list of facilities.

facilities.label: Matter Reactor
facilities.notes: Separates recovered Matter Mix into standardized resources, in one of several processing modes. It makes no power - that is the Power Core, which is a state card and not a node.

facilities.label: Mission Dock
facilities.notes: No schematic exists for a mission dock, and none is configured. A dock reports idle until missions are a system, and it draws the keep-the-lights-on 100 meanwhile.
